kb.emptyHint: Ask the bot about Sơn Việt Demo Co.'s quotations or policies, or pick a suggested question below.

chips.c1: How much is the latest quotation?
chips.c2: Why is the rooftop waterproofing unit price at Biệt thự Sen Vàng higher than at Biệt thự Lúa Non?
chips.c3: What percentage of the largest quotation is labour?
chips.c4: How long is the warranty on premium waterproofing?
chips.c5: Is the warranty counted from the contract date or from another date?

notes.synthetic: All data is synthetic: the company "Sơn Việt Demo Co.", 24 projects, 126 work items and 12 policy documents.
notes.privacy: Your questions are not stored. The system only records which feature your invite link used, and when. Each question is sent to Google Gemini to produce the answer.
